amendmentReason: Native comparison found release-specific INSERT diagnostic continuation and required NULL aggregation. Keep all diagnostic observations and add original-SQL witnesses while retaining every previous finite identity and seed.
scope: Ordinary MySQL INSERT VALUES with an explicit, ordered list of signed INT or stock utf8mb4_bin VARCHAR destination fields and one or more rows of native literals or NULL.

Mutation/InsertCell.role: One explicit literal value in an INSERT row.
Mutation/InsertCell.structure: A signed integer literal, a plain UTF-8 text literal or the NULL alternative.
Mutation/InsertCell.conditions: An integer cell occupies a signed INT slot. A text cell occupies a declared VARCHAR slot. NULL may occupy either slot. The owning INSERT matches each cell to the physical destination at the same position.
Mutation/InsertCell.meaning: Supply the exact literal to the ordinary native insert. The resolved destination interprets capacity and nullable policy for the statement row count.
Mutation/InsertCell.sql: Render the signed literal, exact quoted UTF-8 text or the NULL keyword.

structure: An absolute physical relation identity and an ordered, duplicate-free write layout. Every row has one cell for each destination in the same order.
conditions: The typed target must resolve before publication. The list names only writable fields. The direct and analyzed paths check width, position and role. A single-row required-NULL error is a defined native statement effect.
meaning: Store explicit values in the exact named fields, applying native VARCHAR length and nullability behavior. Ordinary single-row INSERT rejects NULL in a required field with SQLSTATE 23000 and vendor code 1048. For multiple rows under empty sql_mode it substitutes the implicit empty string and emits Warning 1048. The same external table supplies constraints and omitted destinations. In the fixed AFTER INSERT fixture, 5.6.51 and 5.7.44 can report truncations from later cells on the same row after a required NULL is encountered. The remaining pinned releases stop at the failing cell. Starting with 5.7.44, multi-row required NULL diagnostics are aggregated per destination, and truncation diagnostics still preserve their multiplicity.
sql: Emit ordinary INSERT with its explicit destinations and every row in order. Use the stock literal forms so the server applies the same storage conversion and effects.
